note: Conservative baseline from the 2026-10-02 evidence audit. This measures proof readiness, not conference acceptance probability.

systems.gap: Relations exist and are visible, but most effects are one-time; long multi-step delayed causal propagation is not yet the authoritative production core.
World_server has persistence/realtime foundations, while Meta6 explicitly lacks authoritative persistent server state and long-horizon autonomous progression.
Live AI prediction works for bounded allowlisted actions; arbitrary natural-language intent is not yet compiled into typed verified world rules/projects.
Population/resources exist conceptually and in MVPs, but persistent memories, autonomous goals, groups, institutions and emergent social dynamics are not yet proven.
Realtime/multiplayer infrastructure exists, but the A -> durable event -> B sees consequence -> B continues the same causal chain proof is not yet the canonical public slice.
VNO, revisions and evidence discipline exist, but a player-facing why-did-this-happen causal replay from seed/event lineage is not yet complete.
Scientific experiment contracts exist, but there is no public multi-world/multi-participant experiment product with cohorts, trajectories and replay.
Independent review and falsification are first-class process concepts; externally reproducible public research packages remain incomplete.
Internal world/action structures exist; a stable public portable world-recipe standard with versioning/fork semantics is not yet established.
Apps/worlds can be added by developers, but no no-code create/publish/fork/remix/lineage ecosystem is proven.
No canonical fresh prior-art/competitor/academic claim validator currently protects world-first claims.
Several compelling pieces are proven, but not yet one 60-second end-to-end proof combining free intent, durable multi-step consequence, shared world and reproducible evidence.

lastDelta.reason: Initial baseline only; no user success/failure classification is recorded by this readiness system.
